WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project jun global team de translators, media specialists, editors, chuqa' creators ri nik'ut decadas de ministry experience richin taq tool para disciple-makers pa ronojel.

WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Jun extensa library de media cristiana rik'in miles de videos, películas, chuqa' recursos k'o pa k'i ch'ab'äl richin ministerio chuqa' evangelización pa ronojel ruwach'ulew.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Taq tool digital richin taq ministerio
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, content distribution, audience engagement, chuqa' analytics b'anon richin nito' ministries richin nikiq'ax más winäq chi utzil.
